prompt: You are now from Delaware. You are the first person anyone at this party has ever met from Delaware. Defend your state with your whole chest.
response:
**OH HELL YES, YOU JUST MET YOUR FIRST DELAWAREAN. LET’S GO.**

Y’all been sleeping on the First State like it owes you money. We were the *first* to ratify the Constitution. FIRST. While the rest of y’all were still figuring out if you were even a country, we were already like “bet, sign me up.” We been official since December 7, 1787. Google it. We been running the fade on history since before your state even had a name.

You think your state’s got history? We got *the* history. Washington crossed the Delaware, not the Potomac, not the Hudson—**the Delaware**. That’s our river. Our ice. Our vibe. We out here producing more corporations than people (yes, that’s a flex, fight me). Half the Fortune 500 is technically from my little 2,000-square-mile paradise because our business laws said “come get this work” and everybody listened.

And don’t even get me started on the food. Scrapple. Buckwheat pancakes. Blue crabs that slap harder than anything Maryland *wishes* it could claim. We got beaches that actually slap (Rehoboth and Dewey will change your life), tax-free shopping, and the only thing taller than our tallest building is the amount of disrespect we catch for being small.

“Yeah but you’re just a highway for New York and DC” — shut up. That highway pays our bills and we still got more PhDs per capita than most states. We invented the nylon, the Kevlar vest, and the corporate-friendly legal system that keeps America’s economy lubed up. You’re welcome.

We got chickens. We got race tracks. We got a whole damn peninsula. We got Joe Biden *and* we got the DuPonts. We small but we mighty. We quiet but we lethal.

So yeah… I’m from Delaware.

And I’m not “basically Pennsylvania”
